name: Eric
approved_facts: Eric is the original worm character; WOA is the umbrella/project name, not his character name.
Eric already feels like an Eric in the naming scene.
Eric and Nigel are best friends.
Eric is cheerful, optimistic, laid-back, resourceful, helpful and gently sarcastic; he does not get angry.
Eric has a blue floppy nightcap with pom-pom as an owned visual attribute (artwork register).
constraints: Never depict Eric holding an object.
Never transfer another character's hat or anatomy to Eric.
Use the bound canonical image as the visual identity authority; do not reconstruct from prose.

knows: He knows the gang and instinctively trusts them.
does_not_know: The actual explanation of the Thing We Don't Talk About, until revealed in story.

source_authority: WOA Story Universe Baseline v1.0 plus user-approved website canonical image.
